sm-7HE9.title: Guardrail: divided road with metal rail
sm-7HE9.summary: The only divided road in the country, running from Dogana to the city, with the two lanes split by a metal guardrail.

sm-8OjL.title: Pole: round concrete
sm-8OjL.summary: Most poles are round and made of concrete, just like in Italy. Some wooden poles exist too.

sm-9e8C.title: Bollard: same as Italy, signs point to Rimini
sm-9e8C.summary: Road signs and bollards look just like Italy's. Many signs point to the Italian city of Rimini.

sm-B9B0.title: Plate: short, white, blue letters
sm-B9B0.summary: Short white plates with blue letters. Most other European plates are longer and have a blue strip on the side.

sm-Fpf0.title: Landscape: farm hills, lush Mediterranean
sm-Fpf0.summary: Smooth farmland hills with many small winding roads and lush, Mediterranean-looking plants.

sm-HAjS.title: Google car: lime-green bins
sm-HAjS.summary: Lime-green bins are common along the road. Some newer Gen 4 coverage has black bins instead.

sm-RCBb.title: Sign: painted blue crosswalk, hanging sign
sm-RCBb.summary: Fancy pedestrian crossings with a blue painted crosswalk and a sign hanging over the road. Only found here.

sm-XqN5.title: Chevron: yellow with burgundy arrows
sm-XqN5.summary: Yellow chevron signs with burgundy-red arrows. No other country uses this colour mix.

sm-nInM.title: Google car: old Gen 3 camera in old town
sm-nInM.summary: The historic centre was filmed with the older Gen 3 trekker camera, which looks blurrier with softer colours.

sm-nbvK.title: Landscape: hill with three towers
sm-nbvK.summary: A 739 m hill with three towers on top, visible from almost everywhere. If you spot the three towers, it is San Marino.
